title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Annual Four-Item Acceptance and Follow-Up Arrangements
prompt:
The pie chart below shows the distribution of four items (Item A, Item B, Item C, and Item D) in the annual acceptance check for a simulated community project in 2023. The chart represents the percentage of each item among the total accepted items.

Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请根据饼图描述四项验收内容的占比，总结主要特征并进行比较。不要表达个人观点或解释原因。
